title: Full System
description: Low oxygen, high waste, and a real growth target, all at once. Everything you've built so far, in one cell.

narrative.intro: No more single-problem tissue samples. This one has thin oxygen and a waste-saturated environment at the same time, and you're still expected to actually grow, not just survive. Nothing here is new — every part you've used before is available — but nothing here is optional either.
narrative.outro: Respiration efficiency, active waste management, and growth allocation, all running at once and all still balancing. That's not a bigger version of the first cell you built — it's every constraint you've met so far, holding simultaneously.

environment.description: Thin oxygen, waste-saturated tissue — the hardest environment yet.

goals.description: Keep cytoplasmic ATP at or above 2 for 10 straight ticks.
Accumulate at least 3 units of biomass.
Keep internal waste at or below 6.

failConditions.description: Internal waste hit toxic levels — the cell is dead.
ATP flatlined at zero for 15 ticks — the cell is dead.
